post_topics.title: Discover Your 16-Season Palette
post_topics.text: Professional fabric draping reveals the colors that complement your skin, eyes, and hair. Each personal color analysis includes a physical color wallet plus guidance for hair, makeup, outfits, and accessories. Appointments are available across South Florida. {booking_url}

post_topics.title: Refresh Your Wardrobe
post_topics.text: A wardrobe edit can turn an overcrowded closet into a practical collection that works with your best colors and personal style. In-home wardrobe edits are available across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach County. {booking_url}

post_topics.title: Make It a Color Party
post_topics.text: Share the color-analysis experience with friends, family, or colleagues. Royal Color group parties give each participant personalized color guidance in a memorable group setting. Groups of 2-5 are welcome. {booking_url}

post_topics.title: Shop With Your Best Colors
post_topics.text: Personal shopping support makes it easier to choose flattering clothing and accessories that fit your palette, lifestyle, and budget. Sessions are available in stores across South Florida or online. {booking_url}
